ETC-901.title: Position report references the last passed LRBG compliant balise group
ETC-901.preconditions: On-board equipment is in a level where position reports are sent to the RBC; a radio session with the RBC is established.
ETC-901.test_inputs: Balise groups BG1 and BG2 on the route, both LRBG compliant according to SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 a).
ETC-901.assumptions: The test data designer determines LRBG compliance of each balise group (linked/unlinked marking and linking consistency checking) according to SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 a); the requirement text itself does not state the compliance rules.

steps.action: Run the train over BG1 and trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report sent to the RBC uses BG1 as the reference balise group.

steps.action: Run the train over BG2 and trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report sent to the RBC uses BG2 as the reference balise group.

ETC-901.title: A non LRBG compliant balise group is not used as position reference
ETC-901.preconditions: On-board equipment is in a level where position reports are sent to the RBC; a radio session with the RBC is established.
ETC-901.test_inputs: Balise group BG1 (LRBG compliant) followed by balise group BG2 (not LRBG compliant).
ETC-901.assumptions: BG2 is configured, by its linked/unlinked marking and the linking consistency checking state, so that it is not LRBG compliant according to SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 a).

steps.action: Run the train over BG1 and trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report uses BG1 as the reference balise group.

steps.action: Run the train over BG2 and trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report still uses BG1 as the reference balise group; BG2 is not used as reference.

ETC-902.title: Information valid for the train orientation is taken into account
ETC-902.preconditions: On-board equipment is operational with a known train orientation.
ETC-902.test_inputs: A message from a transmission medium containing information marked valid for the current train orientation.

steps.action: Transmit the information valid for the current train orientation to the on-board equipment.
steps.expected: The on-board equipment takes the information into account (it is stored and used by the on-board functions).

ETC-902.title: Information not valid for the train orientation is ignored
ETC-902.preconditions: On-board equipment is operational with a known train orientation.
ETC-902.test_inputs: A message from a transmission medium containing information marked valid only for the direction opposite to the current train orientation.
ETC-902.assumptions: The chosen information and operating situation are not covered by any of the exceptions referenced in SUBSET-026 §3.6.3.1.3.

steps.action: Transmit the information valid only for the opposite direction to the on-board equipment.
steps.expected: The on-board equipment ignores the information; on-board data and supervision remain unchanged.

ETC-903.title: Stored linking information is replaced before SOLR is determined on reception of linking information
ETC-903.preconditions: On-board equipment holds stored linking information; on-board internal state (stored linking information, SOLR) can be observed via a test interface or log.
ETC-903.test_inputs: New linking information that differs from the stored linking information.
ETC-903.assumptions: The order of internal processing (replacement, then SOLR determination) is observable through the test interface or on-board log.

steps.action: Transmit the new linking information to the on-board equipment.
steps.expected: Stored linking information is replaced as specified for linking information.

steps.action: Inspect the SOLR determined after reception.
steps.expected: The SOLR is determined after the replacement, i.e. it is derived from the linking information as replaced, not from the previously stored linking information.

ETC-903.title: Replacement before SOLR determination also applies to linking information released from the transition buffer
ETC-903.preconditions: On-board equipment holds stored linking information and has linking information held in the transition buffer; internal state is observable via a test interface or log.
ETC-903.test_inputs: Linking information in the transition buffer that differs from the stored linking information.
ETC-903.assumptions: The release of the buffered linking information is caused by the corresponding level transition in the test scenario.

steps.action: Cause the release of the linking information from the transition buffer.
steps.expected: Stored linking information is replaced with the released linking information as specified.

steps.action: Inspect the SOLR determined after the release.
steps.expected: The SOLR is determined after the replacement, using the linking information as replaced.

ETC-904.title: New SSP replaces stored SSP from its start location
ETC-904.preconditions: On-board equipment holds a stored Static Speed Profile covering locations A to C.
ETC-904.test_inputs: New Static Speed Profile starting at location B (A < B < C) with speed values different from the stored profile.

steps.action: Transmit the new Static Speed Profile to the on-board equipment.
steps.expected: The information is accepted.

steps.action: Inspect the stored Static Speed Profile between A and B.
steps.expected: The previously stored profile is unchanged between A and B.

steps.action: Inspect the stored Static Speed Profile from B onward over the extent of the new information.
steps.expected: The new profile values are in effect from B; the old values are no longer used there.

ETC-904.title: New SSP starting exactly at the stored SSP start replaces it
ETC-904.preconditions: On-board equipment holds a stored Static Speed Profile starting at location A.
ETC-904.test_inputs: New Static Speed Profile starting at location A with different speed values.

steps.action: Transmit the new Static Speed Profile to the on-board equipment.
steps.expected: The information is accepted.

steps.action: Inspect the stored Static Speed Profile from A onward over the extent of the new information.
steps.expected: The new profile values are in effect from A; no stored value from the old profile remains in that range.

ETC-905.title: MA request is sent when the RBC-defined triggering criterion is reached
ETC-905.preconditions: Radio session with the RBC established; the RBC has defined an MA request triggering criterion; train is running under an MA.
ETC-905.assumptions: No other reason for sending an MA request applies during the test.

steps.action: Run the train until the triggering criterion defined by the RBC is reached.
steps.expected: The on-board equipment sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the MA request message.
steps.expected: The MA request informs the RBC of the reason corresponding to the reached triggering criterion.

ETC-905.title: No criterion-based MA request before the triggering criterion is reached
ETC-905.preconditions: Radio session with the RBC established; the RBC has defined an MA request triggering criterion; train is running under an MA.
ETC-905.assumptions: No other reason for sending an MA request applies during the test.

steps.action: Run the train until just before the triggering criterion is reached.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent.

steps.action: Continue until the criterion is reached.
steps.expected: An MA request is sent at the point the criterion is reached.

ETC-905.title: All reasons applicable at sending time are reported with the MA request
ETC-905.preconditions: Radio session with the RBC established; the RBC has defined an MA request triggering criterion.
ETC-905.assumptions: A second reason for sending an MA request is made applicable by the test scenario at the time the triggering criterion is reached.

steps.action: Make the second reason applicable and run the train until the triggering criterion is reached.
steps.expected: An MA request is sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the reasons reported in the MA request.
steps.expected: Both reasons applicable at the time of sending are reported to the RBC.

KDH-901.title: Minimum length enforced for single-factor passwords
KDH-901.preconditions: User is on the password set/change page for an account using the password as a single-factor authentication mechanism.
KDH-901.test_inputs: Passwords of length N_SF - 1 and N_SF.
KDH-901.assumptions: N_SF is the single-factor minimum length specified in NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.1.1.2 and configured in the portal; the value is not given in the requirement text.

steps.action: Submit a password of N_SF - 1 characters.
steps.expected: The password is rejected because it is shorter than the minimum length.

steps.action: Submit a password of N_SF characters.
steps.expected: The password is accepted.

KDH-901.title: Minimum length enforced for passwords used in multi-factor authentication
KDH-901.preconditions: User is on the password set/change page for an account where the password is used only as part of multi-factor authentication.
KDH-901.test_inputs: Passwords of length N_MF - 1 and N_MF.
KDH-901.assumptions: N_MF is the multi-factor minimum length specified in NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.1.1.2 and configured in the portal; the value is not given in the requirement text.

steps.action: Submit a password of N_MF - 1 characters.
steps.expected: The password is rejected because it is shorter than the minimum length.

steps.action: Submit a password of N_MF characters.
steps.expected: The password is accepted.

KDH-901.title: Submitted password that differs from the stored password is rejected
KDH-901.preconditions: An account with a known valid password exists.
KDH-901.test_inputs: The valid password, and a variant of it with one character changed.

steps.action: Log in with the valid password.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds.

steps.action: Log in with the variant password.
steps.expected: Authentication fails.

KDH-902.title: Authenticator is disabled when the consecutive failed attempt limit is reached
KDH-902.preconditions: A subscriber account with a known valid authenticator exists and has no recent failed attempts.
KDH-902.assumptions: L is the consecutive failed attempt limit configured according to NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.2.2; the value is not given in the requirement text.

steps.action: Make L - 1 consecutive failed authentication attempts.
steps.expected: Each attempt fails with an authentication error; the authenticator is not yet disabled.

steps.action: Make one more failed authentication attempt (attempt L).
steps.expected: The attempt fails and the rate limiting is applied to the authenticator.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate with the valid authenticator.
steps.expected: Authentication is refused because the authenticator was disabled by rate limiting.

KDH-902.title: Successful authentication interrupts the consecutive failure count
KDH-902.preconditions: A subscriber account with a known valid authenticator exists and has no recent failed attempts.
KDH-902.test_inputs: Invalid credentials; valid credentials; limit L.
KDH-902.assumptions: L as configured per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.2.2.

steps.action: Make L - 1 consecutive failed attempts, then authenticate successfully.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds.

steps.action: Make L - 1 further failed attempts, then authenticate with valid credentials.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds; the authenticator is not disabled because the failures were not consecutive.

KDH-902.title: Disabled authenticator is handled as specified
KDH-902.preconditions: An authenticator has been disabled by rate limiting (see KDH-902-TC01).
KDH-902.assumptions: The handling procedure for disabled authenticators is the one defined in NIST SP 800-63B-4 §3.2.2; the requirement text does not describe it.

steps.action: Attempt to authenticate with the disabled authenticator.
steps.expected: Authentication is refused.

steps.action: Perform the handling procedure for disabled authenticators defined in §3.2.2, then authenticate.
steps.expected: The authenticator is usable again only after the procedure has been completed.

KDH-903.title: Every portal page declares its default human language
KDH-903.preconditions: Access to the full list of portal pages, including authenticated pages.
KDH-903.assumptions: Portal pages are HTML; the language is declared with the lang attribute of the html element. The default language of the portal content is Turkish (tr).

steps.action: For each portal page, inspect the html element in the rendered DOM.
steps.expected: A lang attribute is present and not empty.

steps.action: Compare the declared value with the main language of the page content.
steps.expected: The declared language matches the default human language of the page.

KDH-903.title: Language is declared also on error and dynamically generated pages
KDH-903.test_inputs: A non-existent URL, the login page, a server error page, a page rendered after client-side navigation.
KDH-903.assumptions: Portal pages are HTML; the language is declared with the lang attribute of the html element.

steps.action: Open each listed page and inspect the html element.
steps.expected: Each page has a non-empty lang attribute declaring its default language.

KDH-904.title: Kullanıcı oturumu kapattığında oturum sonlanır
KDH-904.preconditions: Kullanıcı portala kimlik doğrulamasıyla giriş yapmıştır.
KDH-904.assumptions: Tedbirin ayrıntıları (süreler, oturumu sonlandıran diğer olaylar) gereksinim metninde verilmemiştir; bu test yalnızca kullanıcının oturumu kapatmasını kapsar.

steps.action: Oturumu kapat işlevini kullan.
steps.expected: Oturum sonlanır ve kullanıcı oturum açılmamış duruma döner.

steps.action: Kimlik doğrulama gerektiren bir sayfayı aynı tarayıcıda yeniden aç.
steps.expected: Sayfaya erişilemez; kullanıcıdan yeniden kimlik doğrulaması istenir.

KDH-905.title: Organization-defined action is taken when the invalid logon limit is exceeded
KDH-905.preconditions: A user account with known valid credentials exists and has no recent invalid logon attempts.
KDH-905.assumptions: The system security plan sets N = 3 consecutive invalid logon attempts and the action 'lock the account for 15 minutes'; values are not given in the requirement text.

steps.action: Make N consecutive invalid logon attempts.
steps.expected: Each attempt is rejected; no lock action is taken yet.

steps.action: Make one more invalid logon attempt.
steps.expected: The limit is exceeded and the account is automatically locked as defined in the system security plan.

steps.action: Attempt to log on with valid credentials during the lock.
steps.expected: Logon is refused while the account is locked.

KDH-905.title: Successful logon interrupts the consecutive invalid attempt count
KDH-905.preconditions: A user account with known valid credentials exists and has no recent invalid logon attempts.
KDH-905.test_inputs: Invalid password; valid password; limit N.
KDH-905.assumptions: N = 3 per the system security plan.

steps.action: Make N invalid logon attempts, then log on with valid credentials.
steps.expected: Logon succeeds.

steps.action: Log off, make one invalid logon attempt, then log on with valid credentials.
steps.expected: Logon succeeds; the earlier invalid attempts are not counted as consecutive with the new one and no action is taken.
